notes: Adversarial slice for the skill router. Every prompt here is phrased the
way the problem is actually experienced, using none of the content tokens
in the target skill's id or description. The router scores by token
overlap, so this slice is expected to score far below the main fixture.
It exists to make that gap visible and measurable rather than implied:
the main fixture reports what the router does when the user already knows
the vocabulary, and this one reports what it does when they do not.
Do not tune the router against this file by adding these words to skill
descriptions - that would move the number without moving the capability.
